datasets.name: N3SDDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT  region_name, sum(rest), sum(dm_hokid_rest),
       sum(dm_enrkimteh_rest), sum(dm_neftsan_rest), sum(dm_ticxid_rest),
       sum(dm_kendtes_rest), sum(dm_belediye_rest), sum(dm_inshate_rest),
       sum(dm_neqliyatr_rest), sum(dm_digersah_rest), sum(oz_rest),
       sum(oz_kimya_rest), sum(oz_neft_san_rest), sum(oz_ticaret_xid_rest),
       sum(oz_kentt_emal_rest), sum(oz_inshat_emalk_rest), sum(oz_ineqliyat_rab),
       sum(oz_diger_sah), sum(fiziki_sexs), sum(fiziki_ipot), sum(diger_kredit),
       sum(maliye)
  FROM cm_n3_sdt 

group by region_name

datasets.name: Crdinfo
datasets.sql:
select 
  crd.id,
  crd.customertype,
  crd.branchid ,
  bp.villageid,
  cust.vid_sob
from 
  cm_portfolio crd,
  cm_business_plan bp,
  smart.customers cust
where 
  bp.creditid = crd.id
  and cust.id = crd.boorowerid

datasets.name: VidDatSet
datasets.sql:
select id,name 
from smart.vid_sob
where id in (select vid_sob 
from cm_sb_customers where 
id in (select boorowerid from cm_portfolio)
and  vid_sob is not null )
